structure Mid where
  username : String
  password : String
  role     : String
  privileges : String
  isCustomer : Bool
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def ValidateContract : Contract Input Mid where
  pre  := fun i => i.username ≠ "" ∧ i.password ≠ "" ∧
                 (i.role = "customer" ∨ i.role = "sales person" ∨ i.role = "administrator") ∧
                 i.isCustomer
  post := fun i m => (m.username = i.username ∧ m.password = i.password ∧
                      m.role = i.role ∧ m.privileges = i.privileges) ↔
                    (i.isCustomer ∧
                     m.username ≠ "" ∧ m.password ≠ "" ∧
                     m.role = "customer" ∧ m.privileges ≠ "")

def ComputeContract : Contract Mid Output where
  pre  := fun m => m.username ≠ "" ∧ m.password ≠ "" ∧
                 m.role = "customer" ∧ m.privileges ≠ ""
  post := fun m o => (o.username = m.username ∧ o.password = m.password ∧
                      o.role = m.role ∧ o.privileges = m.privileges) ↔
                    (m.isCustomer ∧
                     o.username ≠ "" ∧ o.password ≠ "" ∧
                     o.role = "customer" ∧ o.privileges ≠ "")

structure Mid where
  accounts : List Account
  username : String
  deleted  : Bool
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def ValidateContract : Contract Input Mid where
  pre  := fun i => i.username ≠ ""
  post := fun i m => m.deleted = true ∧
                     (∃ a ∈ i.accounts, a.username = i.username) ∧
                     (m.accounts = i.accounts.filter (fun a => a.username ≠ i.username))

def UpdateContract : Contract Mid Output where
  pre  := fun m => m.deleted
  post := fun m o => o.accounts = m.accounts ∧
                     o.deleted = m.deleted

theorem po1 : Contract.Compatible ValidateContract UpdateContract := by
  discharge_po [Spec, UpdateContract, ValidateContract]

theorem po2 : Contract.Refines (ValidateContract.seq UpdateContract) Spec := by
  discharge_po [Spec, UpdateContract, ValidateContract]
